text:
NEW CHARACTER · STEP 7 OF 9

Spells

Choose the spells your School starts with. Each is added to your Equipment as its Spell Scroll and then learned, exactly as on the sheet.

Kuni Shugenja starts with Sense, Commune, Summon, 3 Earth, 2 Fire, 1 Water (Core Rulebook p.107). Each is added to your Equipment as its Spell Scroll and learned.

These are scrolls in your Equipment. Memorising a spell costs XP equal to its Mastery (Core p.164); tick Memorised on its row.

Given by your School
